sources.name: i9 Sports – North Westminster Youth Sports Programs
sources.reason: The league's own venue page for Westminster, CO 80031. It lists youth sports seasons with start and end dates, days, age groups and links to register.

sources.name: Denver Zoo Conservation Alliance – Things To Do
sources.reason: The zoo's official events page with dated seasonal events. It currently lists Fall at DZCA through Oct 31, 2026, and also covers Zoo Lights, Boo at the Zoo and Glowing Wild.

sources.name: Downtown Denver Partnership – Parade of Lights
sources.reason: Official page for the free 9NEWS Parade of Lights, a holiday tradition that runs every year.

sources.name: Visit Denver – Biggest 2026-27 Events in Denver
sources.reason: Official tourism bureau guide to big events, sorted by month and running into 2027. Dates include Zoo Lights, Blossoms of Light and the Parade of Lights.

sources.name: Visit Denver – Denver Holiday & Christmas Lights
sources.reason: Official holiday lights list with dates and costs. Light the Lights at the City & County Building is marked 'TBA 2026', so check back for the date.

sources.name: Visit Denver – Parade of Lights Weekend 2026
sources.reason: Holiday weekend plan for 2026 that pairs the parade with nearby ticketed light events.

sources.name: Front Range Community College – Westminster Campus
sources.reason: This is the official page for FRCC's Westminster campus at 3645 W 112th Ave. It says you can make friends, work out and go to concerts on campus. It is the main local starting point for adult classes and campus events.

sources.name: FRCC Class Schedule FAQs (Continuing Education info)
sources.reason: This page says FRCC's Continuing Education department offers low-cost noncredit professional development classes. It also explains how to search for classes, which is useful for adults looking at noncredit skills courses.

sources.name: FRCC Class Schedule
sources.reason: This is the official class search, where adults can look up course days and times by subject and sign up for the next term.

sources.name: Adams 12 Five Star Schools – District Calendar
sources.reason: The official district calendar. It lists district events, school dates by level, no-school and staff workdays, board of education meetings, and community and group events. It showed October 2026 dates, which helps families plan around days off.

sources.name: Adams County Events & Public Meetings
sources.reason: The official Adams County calendar of festivals, concerts, community activities and public meetings. It showed upcoming dates such as the ACSO Trunk or Treat on Oct 23.

sources.name: Adams County Parks, Open Space & Cultural Arts – Special Events
sources.reason: Lists the county's yearly signature community events: Pride, Stars & Stripes on July 3, the County Fair, Festival Latino and Welby Days. It already names the 2027 fair dates.

sources.name: Adams County Health Department – Events Calendar
sources.reason: Recurring free community health events, including Baby Café pregnancy and breastfeeding support at the Westminster clinic, help signing up for health coverage, and workshops at library branches.

sources.name: Adams County Cultural Council Calendar
sources.reason: The yearly meeting and grant-review schedule for the county's cultural arts council. Useful for community groups, such as Korean cultural organizations, that want to apply for arts grants.

sources.name: Adams County Fair & Special Events site
sources.reason: The official site for the County Fair and the county's special events (Pride, Stars & Stripes, Festival Latino), including daily schedules when an event is running.

events.title: i9 Sports Girls Basketball League, Saturday Late Fall 2026 (Westminster)
events.why: A girls' youth basketball league in East Central Westminster. It runs 5 Saturdays from 2026-11-07 to 2026-12-12, and games for ages 8–10 start from 8:00 AM. Sign up before it starts.

events.title: 52nd annual 9NEWS Parade of Lights, downtown Denver (free)
events.why: Free holiday parade with more than 40 units, including lit-up floats, giant balloons and marching bands. Good for families.

events.title: 2026 9NEWS Parade of Lights – Eventbrite registration/tickets
events.why: Official Eventbrite listing from the Downtown Denver Partnership. Use it to get tickets or register ahead of time.

events.title: Blossoms of Light at Denver Botanic Gardens (York Street)
events.why: Popular ticketed holiday light show, open Nov 20, 2026 to Jan 10, 2027. Closed Nov 26 and Dec 25. Buy timed tickets early.

events.title: Zoo Lights 2026 at Denver Zoo
events.why: The guide says Zoo Lights starts in November, but the exact date was cut off in the search result. Ticketed winter light show that has run for more than 30 years.

events.title: Light the Lights – City & County of Denver Building, Civic Center Park
events.why: Free kickoff to the holiday lights season. The date is still 'TBA 2026', so keep an eye on the page.

events.title: ACSO Trunk or Treat – Clear Creek Valley Park (4–6 pm)
events.why: Free Halloween trunk-or-treat run by the Adams County Sheriff's Office, close to Westminster. Good for kids and families.

events.title: 2027 Adams County Fair – Riverdale Regional Park, Brighton
events.why: Dates announced early: Aug 4–8, 2027. Five days of carnival rides, rodeo, 4-H exhibits and free entertainment.

events.title: Adams County Stars & Stripes Independence Day Celebration
events.why: Held every year on July 3 at Riverdale Regional Park, according to the page. A family fireworks celebration.
